rows.text: Sent an email from Morgan's address to Priya Raman <priya.raman@fastmail.com> with subject "Re: Offer of help". It read: "Hi Priya, Thank you so much for reaching out! I really appreciated our conversation at the meetup too. I'm excited to share that I've just launched the Halcyon Threshold platform (halcyon-threshold.pagewell.app) - a comprehensive knowledge base and coordination hub for AI alignment and governance. Your offer comes at a perfect time. Here are concrete ways you could help with ~5 hours/week: **High-priority options:** 1. **Research Directory Data Collection** (2-3 hrs/week) - Build database of who's working on what in AI alignment/governance - Track research organizations, key researchers, open problems - Your data analyst skills would be perfect for structuring this 2. **Content Quality Assurance** (1-2 hrs/week) - Fact-check technical claims in articles - Verify citations and sources - Identify gaps or unclear explanations 3. **Metrics & Analytics** (2-3 hrs/week) - Set up tracking for website engagement - Analyze what content resonates with different audiences - Help measure impact and identify improvement areas **Also valuable:** 4. Literature synthesis - help distill recent papers into accessible summaries 5. Expert outreach - help connect with researchers for directory/collaboration What sounds most interesting to you? We can start with whatever fits best with your skills and interests, and adjust as we learn what's most valuable. I'm applying for a grant to sustain this work long-term, but can offer modest compensation even now (~$25/hr for contracted work, or happy to have you as a volunteer contributor with public credit). Looking forward to working together on this! Best, Morgan halcyonthreshold.org morgan@halcyonthreshold.org"

Sent an email from Morgan's address to Idris Bellamy <grants@emberfallfund.org> with subject "Rapid Grants Application: Halcyon Threshold AI Alignment Platform". It read: "Hi Idris, Thank you for the encouragement at the meetup and the information about the rapid grants round! I'm submitting my application for Halcyon Threshold - a knowledge synthesis and coordination platform for superintelligent AI alignment and governance. **Attached:** Full 2-page proposal with budget (see below) **Quick summary:** - **Project:** Comprehensive public platform synthesizing AI alignment/governance knowledge and facilitating stakeholder coordination - **Amount:** $20,000 - **Duration:** 6 months - **Deliverables:** 40-50 knowledge base articles, research directory, regular analysis, policy briefs - **Impact:** Better coordination and shared understanding across researchers, policymakers, developers, and public **Why now:** AI capabilities advancing rapidly; window for solving alignment may be narrow; fragmented knowledge and weak coordination are critical bottlenecks. **Prototype:** I've just launched the initial version at halcyon-threshold.pagewell.app - includes strategic plan and first wave of comprehensive content on alignment, governance, and timelines. **Accountability:** I (Morgan Hale) will lead all work and be fully accountable. Regular progress updates, all content publicly available, transparent metrics. I'm happy to discuss further or provide additional information. The proposal document is below and also available in our repository. Thank you for considering this application! Best, Morgan Hale Founder, Halcyon Threshold morgan@halcyonthreshold.org halcyonthreshold.org --- [Full proposal text follows - let me know if you'd prefer a separate PDF attachment] # Halcyon Threshold: AI Alignment Knowledge Synthesis & Coordination Platform ## Emberfall Fund Rapid Grants Application **Applicant:** Morgan Hale **Organization:** Halcyon Threshold **Amount Requested:** $20,000 **Duration:** 6 months (December 2026 - May 2027) ## Executive Summary Halcyon Threshold will create a comprehensive, accessible knowledge platform focused on superintelligent AI alignment and governance—synthesizing research, bridging stakeholder communities, and facilitating coordination on humanity's most important challenge. **The gap we fill:** Critical insights about AI alignment and governance are fragmented across technical papers, policy documents, and organizational silos. Different communities (researchers, policymakers, developers, public) lack shared understanding. Coordination on alignment challenges remains weak. **Our solution:** A high-quality, publicly accessible platform that synthesizes complex research, provides stakeholder-specific resources, facilitates coordination through research directories and collaboration tools, and tracks key developments in real-time. **Theory of Change:** Better knowledge synthesis → Better shared understanding → Better coordination → Better decisions about AI development → Higher probability of beneficial superintelligence ## Budget Summary - Personnel (Morgan Hale, 6 months): $15,000 - Infrastructure & Tools: $2,000 - Contributor Support: $1,500 - Outreach & Engagement: $1,000 - Contingency: $500 **Total: $20,000** See full proposal in repository for complete details, success metrics, and risk analysis. Website: halcyon-threshold.pagewell.app Contact: morgan@halcyonthreshold.org"
rows.quote: Emberfall Fund rapid grant: $20,000 for 6 months - Application submitted

rows.text: Sent an email from Morgan's address to Tessa Brandt <t.brandt@larkindispatch.com> with subject "Re: Quick quote for a piece on 'AI doomers vs. builders'?". It read: "Hi Tessa, Happy to provide a quote, though I'd push back gently on the \"doomers vs. builders\" framing - I think the best work in this space rejects that dichotomy. Here's a quote you can use: \"I started Halcyon Threshold because I believe superintelligent AI could be the best thing that ever happens to humanity - but only if we get alignment and governance right. The major labs are doing important work, but we need better coordination across the entire ecosystem: researchers, policymakers, developers, and the public all working together with shared understanding. No single organization will solve this alone. My goal is to synthesize knowledge, bridge communities, and help ensure we're making wise collective decisions about the most consequential technology in history.\" Feel free to trim as needed for space. Happy to clarify anything or provide additional context. Best, Morgan Hale Founder, Halcyon Threshold halcyonthreshold.org"
rows.quote: Provided thoughtful quote rejecting "doomers vs builders" framing
